## Before Review

- [ ] The change addresses the stated scope and acceptance criteria, or identifies any unfinished items.
- [ ] Related documentation, diagrams, and links are consistent.
- [ ] The pull request diff contains no credentials, personal records, or restricted raw data.
- [ ] Examples and proposed work are clearly distinguished from observed results.

Request review from another team member. Approval is recorded through the review itself; do not prefill an approval or another person's feedback here.
